procedural_matters: CHN 616 represeted by Xin WANG. NZL 135 represented by Francesco Kayrouz. Tian Wang attended the hearing as interpreter for CHN 616. Hearing No. 6 was heard together with hearing No. 7 in accordance with RRS 63.(2)(b) since both hearings arose from the same incident.
facts: Race conditions: wind speed 23–28 knots, gusty.
CHN 616 and NZL 135 both were sailing downwind on port tack.
CHN 616 was clear astern of NZL 135.
CHN 616 established an overlap to windward of NZL 135 with lateral distance of 3 - 4 boats lengths.
NZL 135 dropped the spinnaker and luffed pointing to mark 2S.
CHN 616 held their course.
Slight contact occurred between the leeward side of CHN's spinnaker and NZL's windward side of the wing.
NZL 135 bore away and immediately capsized.
CHN 616 passed ahead of NZL, sailed around 10 m and then capsized.
CHN 616 did not finished the race.
There was no damage.

conclusions: CHN 616 to windward failed to keep clear of NZL 135 to leeward, and broke RRS 11.
CHN 616 did not avoid contact with NZL 135 even though it was reasonably possible, and broke RRS 14(a).
It was not reasonably possible for NZL 135 the right-of-way boat to avoid contact with CHN 616 when it became clear that CHN 616 was not keeping clear. NZL 135 did not break RRS 14(a).
decision: The protest is upheld. Since CHN 616 took an applicable penalty, she is not further penalized under RRS 60.5(c)(2).
